Name: True Rune - Haley's Hidden Chapter - Prelude
Author: Riou0903
Description:
[size=5][b]True Rune: Haley's Hidden Chapter — Prelude[/b][/size]
[size=3][i]A psychological slow-burn Haley expansion. Branching heart events. Inner-thought dialogue. The "Love is War" layer beneath the photographer's smile.[/i][/size]

[color=#FF8C00][b]⚠ Not canon — but canon-inspired.[/b][/color] Treat this like a fan-novella set in the same valley: same people, deeper room. Every line is written to feel like Haley always could have said it — you just never stayed long enough to hear it.

[size=4][b]The pitch[/b][/size]

You walk into Pelican Town on day one with mud on your boots, and Haley says something dismissive. Most mods would stop there. [b]This one shows you what she's thinking when she says it.[/b]

Haley's Hidden Chapter is a [b]choice-driven character study[/b] that runs underneath her surface attitude — the polished, slightly cold girl from the base game — and slowly reveals the person performing it. Inspired by the "what they [i]don't[/i] say" tension of [i]Kaguya-sama: Love is War[/i], every scene gives you her spoken line [b]and[/b] her unspoken one:

[code]
Haley: "Don't think that means anything, okay?"
Haley: (...At least he noticed.)[/code]
That gap — between what she says and what she means — is the entire hook. And [b]you[/b] decide how it closes.

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/47114/47114-1780500939-1982006560.png[/img]
[size=1][i]↑ Screenshot: Haley's spoken line vs. her inner monologue — the "Love is War" beat in action.[/i][/size][/center]

[size=4][b]Why this plays differently from other event mods[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Your choices actually fork the story.[/b] This isn't "pick the nice option for +friendship." The very first meeting (LH00) splits three ways — [color=#9ACD32]sincere[/color], [color=#9ACD32]tease[/color], or [color=#9ACD32]cold[/color] — and that choice sets flags that change [b]which version of every later event you get[/b], all the way to how she asks you to the Flower Dance and which letter she sends you at the beach.[/*]
[*][b]Dialogue that remembers.[/b] Pick the grounded answer in your first conversation and Haley's everyday town dialogue [i]rewrites itself[/i] to match — she comments on your dirty hands, your work ethic, the fact that you don't brag. Flag-driven, for the rest of the playthrough.[/*]
[*][b]A real branching tree, not a straight line.[/b] LH00 → LH01 → LH02 → LH03 → LH04's promise/lean fork → LH05A/B → LH06A/B finale. Plus NPC-only interludes where Emily checks in on Haley after you've left — scenes you're not even in, written so you can feel the version of her you don't get to see.[/*]
[*][b]Subtext over fan-service.[/b] The romance is earned in glances, deflections, and the lines she cuts herself off from finishing. Slow burn, on purpose.[/*]
[/list]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/47114/47114-1780500905-187584438.png[/img]
[size=1][i]↑ Screenshot: a branching choice menu — sincere / tease / cold, each opening a different path.[/i][/size]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/47114/47114-1780500901-968046126.png[/img]
[size=1][i]↑ Screenshot: the outcome of that choice — how Haley reacts and what it sets in motion.[/i][/size][/center]

[size=4][b]The Flower Dance Courtship — Event Based[/b][/size]

Its no longer just the simple "ask at the flowerdance". There's a [b]written scene[/b] there are also [b]dialogue lines[/b] that will let you know she is looking for a dance partner. She finds you before the festival, fumbles her way toward almost-asking, and hands [i]you[/i] the moment:

[list]
[*][color=#9ACD32]Tease[/color] her for hinting and watch her crack.[/*]
[*]Ask her [color=#9ACD32]gently[/color] and catch the line: [i]"When did anyone last make me feel like an easy yes?"[/i][/*]
[*]Go [color=#9ACD32]confident[/color] — "You're my partner. I'll make you my flower queen."[/*]
[/list]
The relationship itself is [b]event-based too[/b]: Dating status is set inside the story beats (the LH06 finales), not bolted on with a friendship number. You become a couple because a scene earned it.

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/47114/47114-1780500915-929795396.png[/img]
[size=1][i]↑ Screenshot: the Flower Dance ask scene / Haley as flower queen.[/i][/size][/center]

[size=4][b]"Be mine" — the girlfriend ask[/b][/size]

The Prelude doesn't end on a friendship meter ticking over. It ends on a [b]written confession scene[/b]. After everything — the letter, the wall she finally lowers — she gives you the room, and the words are [b]yours to choose[/b]:

[list]
[*][color=#9ACD32]Gentle[/color] — say it plainly, sincerely.[/*]
[*][color=#9ACD32]Confident[/color] — decide it, and let her catch up.[/*]
[*][color=#9ACD32]Flirty[/color] — make her laugh on the way to yes.[/*]
[*][color=#9ACD32]Tease[/color] — call all the way back to the day you teased her about her hair.[/*]
[/list]
And the scene answers you back differently depending on [b]who you've been the whole way through[/b] — whether you were ice or sincere at the start, whether you sent the photo, what you said at the beach. Then she's your girlfriend because [i]she chose it out loud[/i] — Dating set inside the story, not bolted on.

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/47114/47114-1780500889-1601985223.png[/img]
[size=1][i]↑ Screenshot: asking Haley to be your girlfriend — the confession scene and her answer.[/i][/size][/center]

[size=4][b]What's in the Prelude[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]LH00 — First Meeting[/b] — Town entrance. Three-way branch + a chained sub-event that first hints the attitude is performance.[/*]
[*][b]LH01 — Pierre's[/b] — A second crossing of paths, framed by what she [i]almost[/i] says.[/*]
[*][b]LH02 — Beach[/b] — Camera, tide, conversation. Mostly subtext.[/*]
[*][b]LH03 — Before the Flower Dance[/b] — The ask. Tease / gentle / confident.[/*]
[*][b]LH04 — The Fork[/b] — A promise-vs-lean branch that gates everything after it.[/*]
[*][b]LH05A / LH05B[/b] — Diverging beats depending on the path you took.[/*]
[*][b]LH06A / LH06B — The Finale[/b] — Two different endings to the Prelude. One sets Dating. One sends a letter.[/*]
[*][b]Interludes (IN00 / IN01)[/b] — NPC-only cutscenes. Emily and Haley, the evenings after — variants per your choices.[/*]
[*][b]A flag-reactive Haley dialogue file[/b] — her town chatter changes based on who you've been to her.[/*]
[/list]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/47114/47114-1780501514-221257264.png[/img]
[size=1][i]↑ Screenshot: an Emily/Haley interlude — a scene you're not in, about the version of her you don't get to see.[/i][/size][/center]

[size=4][b]This is a Prelude — and that's the point[/b][/size]

What you're downloading is [b]Act One[/b]: first meeting through becoming a couple. It's complete and playable on its own — a full arc with a real ending.

But there's so much more written into this character than one act can hold. [b]If enough people play the Prelude and want more,[/b] I'll continue the story into the next set of events — [b]the proposal, the wedding, and married life[/b] — same branching, same inner-monologue style, same care.

[b]Downloads and endorsements are the green light.[/b] If you want to see where Haley's chapter goes, that's how you tell me. Endorse it, leave a comment with the path you took, and I'll keep building.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI 4.0+[/url][/*]
[*][b]True Rune: Events[/b] — the branching-event engine this story runs on[/*]
[*][b]True Rune: Dialogue Director[/b] — powers the flag-reactive everyday dialogue[/*]
[*]Drop the unzipped folder into [color=#9ACD32]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/color], load a save, and walk toward Town's south entrance.[/*]
[/list]
No config, no setup. Stacks alongside Content Patcher and most custom-NPC mods.

[size=4][b]Compatibility & notes[/b][/size]

SMAPI 4.0+ / Stardew Valley 1.6+. [b]Vanilla Haley heart events are not suppressed by default[/b] — if you want only this storyline, install [b]True Rune: Modder Toolkit[/b] and mark the vanilla Haley events seen once on a fresh save (instructions in the README).

[size=4][b]Permissions & credits[/b][/size]

Story / dialogue / event JSON licensed [b]CC-BY-NC-SA 4.0[/b] — translate, remix, and share under the same terms; no commercial use without permission. Character study and pacing borrow heavily from [i]Kaguya-sama: Love is War[/i]. Built on the [b]True Rune Toolkit[/b].
